decisions.reason: As a close-to-core door lever handle family that survived at least through 2019, it likely met modest aspiration levels and, in a large firm with broad range and slack, is cheap to retain as part of the established portfolio.

This door handle design also remained visible beyond launch, suggesting satisfactory enough performance, and its strong fit with the firm's design-led core business makes continued market presence more likely than withdrawal.

The electronic access system matches the firm's strategic move toward integrated digital building solutions, and a large innovative firm with its own R&D is likely to continue backing such a product unless results clearly fall below aspiration.
